body:
The 963Hz Frequency is associated with higher awareness, mental clarity, and expanded perception. This Frequency Ring was created to support clear thinking, focused attention, and intuitive alignment—without overstimulation.

Solid copper at the center amplifies energetic conductivity, while Clear Quartz anchors both ends to stabilize and magnify the frequency. Black Rutilated Quartz works to clear mental interference, energetic noise, and subconscious distractions that cloud focus. Labradorite enhances perception and insight, supporting clarity during decision-making and intuitive work.

White Mother of Pearl brings a calming, balancing energy to the mind, helping prevent mental burnout while maintaining alertness. Together, these stones create a refined frequency circuit that supports sustained focus, clarity, and awareness.

Wrapped in gold wire, the ring creates a continuous energetic flow that works quietly in the background, helping you stay mentally aligned and clear throughout the day.

For best results, charge this ring on your 963Hz Frequency Generator to keep its energetic field precise and strong.
